data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Norse ‘hans’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘son’. This name was popular in the Viking era, and its Christian form has continued to be used in the Western world. The name Hanson carries the meaning “God's son” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hanson usually hope their child will grow to embody god's son and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hanson can be considered a blend of both Christian and Norse influences, as it is derived from the Old Norse word ‘hans’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘son’. This name may have been popular among the early Christian communities in Scandinavia, who integrated the pagan gods into their new faith. The name Hanson reflects the fusion of cultures during the late Viking Age and the emergence of Christianity in Europe.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hanson carries a deep spiritual meaning, as it refers to God as a Father and the bearer of the name as a divine offspring. It signifies a strong connection to the divine and is a reminder of the power and love of God. This name embodies the belief in a God who is both transcendent and immanent in the lives of His people.
